info.title: Restaurant Operations Platform: local server API
info.description: Generated from @rp/contracts by `pnpm contracts:docs`; do not edit by hand. Money is integer paise, rates are basis points, dates are YYYY-MM-DD and instants are ISO-8601 UTC. `x-capability` names the permission the server enforces (AUTH-010): a capability, `SESSION` (any signed-in person), `DEVICE` (a paired device, nobody signed in) or `PUBLIC`; `x-requirements` lists the BRD requirement IDs. Components cover every exported contract schema, including those not yet used by a route. A `<Name>Input` component describes what a client may send when it differs from the parsed form (for example omitted defaults).
